title: Implement ShoppingList Checklist View
description: Create `ShoppingList` and `ShoppingListItem` in one source file, with raw text storage plus a computed checklist-item view derived from the GFM checklist regex and line indices.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingList.swift` defines `ShoppingList` and `ShoppingListItem` with the public API from the spec.
`items` recomputes checklist items from `text` on each access in document order.
Checklist detection honours `^\s*-\s+\[([ xX])\]\s+(.+)$`, records 0-based `lineIndex`, and preserves the captured item text verbatim.
`ShoppingList(text).text == text` remains true for any input.
